files.desc: Game exe with all code changes: borderless window, Night/Day only, FPS + Ping (every 3 s), health bars, bar numbers, Aggro List, Player Kills counter, chat input keeps focus when you get hit, bigger world map (right-click = Back, maps open fully zoomed out), skips the logos and server list at start, centred Action camera, Locked Target, Forced Move blocked, Tab ignore fix, mail Get All, Max Zoom, Zoom Speed, Display Mode, Compatibility mode. The windows and buttons for these come from the interface files below.
Turns off the debug console.
Forced Move needs more stamina than anyone has, so it can't be used.
Loading screen at game start shows only the Swordsman logo (no Perfect World logo, no book).
The Aggro List window on the left side under the quest area. Install together with gameui.dcf (works with the game exe).
Bigger chat box by default (450x300); you can still resize it.
Hides the target info popup in the middle of the screen.
0-100 numbers under the Stamina, Rage and Warsoul bars (works with the game exe).
Game window list: adds the Aggro List (left side) and the Player Kills counter. Install together with aggrolist.xml and killcount.xml.
Text fix: the chat cooldown message now names the Alliance Channel instead of Dragon's Roar.
The Player Kills counter above your character portrait. Install together with gameui.dcf (works with the game exe).
Adds the Get All button to the mailbox (works with the game exe).
Adds the FPS + Ping line under the minimap (works with the game exe).
Wider recipe list in every crafting window so long item names fit. Install together with the crafting background (surfaces).
Settings > Control Scheme: rows and columns aligned, two label fixes.
Reorganized Settings > Gameplay tab, incl. the Show Players Health Bar checkbox (works with the game exe).
Settings > Key Bind list view: clearer column and button names.
Settings > Key Bind keyboard view: smaller key text so action names don't overlap.
Redesigned Settings > System tab (Graphics, Sound, Display, Camera and World) with Display Mode, Max Zoom, Zoom Speed, Compatibility mode, Night/Day only. Needs the game exe.
Smaller map name labels on the world map.
Lets you zoom the camera out further on every map.
